content.text: {"issues":[{"where":"Research Question 1 / Phase 1","problem":"Detection rate is measured against scripted fault injections on the company's own test bench, but the baseline autoencoder's reconstruction error is a self-referential measure of deviation from what it learned — without any ground-truth labelled anomalies in the training or evaluation data, a high detection rate on scripted faults only shows the method responds to the scripted signal, not that it generalises to real attacks.","fix":"Add an independent held-out evaluation set containing at least some externally sourced or testbed-generated labelled Modbus/BACnet attack traces (e.g. from a published OT testbed dataset) so the baseline metric is checked against cases not derived from the model's own training distribution alone."},{"where":"Research Question 3 / Phase 3","problem":"The compressed model's detection rate is compared only to the uncompressed baseline on the same scripted fault set, which checks the compression against itself and cannot show whether the compressed model still detects anything meaningful if the uncompressed baseline was already weak.","fix":"Require the detection-rate threshold for the compressed model to be stated as an absolute minimum (e.g. ≥90% on the scripted fault set) rather than relative to the uncompressed baseline, so the measure is not solely self-referential."},{"where":"Phase 4 – field validation","problem":"The plan assumes live anonymised traffic from a customer site will be available for field validation, but no customer has offered or agreed to this; the term sheet lists only historical anonymised logs, not live site access.","fix":"Add to the plan an explicit step where the company confirms and documents customer consent for live traffic collection before Phase 4 begins, or replace live validation with a replay of held-out historical logs on the deployed sensor."}],"unconfirmed":["Associate Professor research lead, part-time","Anomaly detection model design, concept-drift handling, edge optimisation"]}
